name: Lumberyard Bistro
description: A Paris street corner at day: 2.8 million triangles, 1,296 meshes and 132 textured PBR materials. A benchmark for drawing, shadows and texture memory.
credit: Amazon Lumberyard Bistro by Amazon Lumberyard, from NVIDIA's Open Research Content Archive (ORCA), licensed CC BY 4.0. Lila converts the exterior to a .lila and changes its sun to a white one.
